interface.shortDescription: Own the ATM MCP runtime and harness workflow
interface.longDescription: Use the AgentTaskManager plugin to register the local ATM MCP server, bootstrap the optional operator surface, and load the bundled cross-repo harness skill. The harness owns memory lookup and repo sync, repo-context and worker-context include memory, and changed files are synced automatically.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentTaskManager for repo context, worker context, harness-owned memory, and git workflow
Expect harness transcript messages for memory lookup, Java symbol preload, semantic sync, tool policy, tool calls, and git workflow outcome
Start the local ATM MCP runtime for this repo
Bring up the ATM operator surface if local HTTP control is needed
Treat repo-context and worker-context as the memory-bearing entry points, rely on automatic changed-file and Java-symbol sync, and collapse each diff-producing prompt into one git workflow commit
